mechanism: Both drugs undergo hepatic metabolism via CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, with potential for additive CNS depression and metabolic competition; progesterone may inhibit fluphenazine metabolism increasing its levels.
action: Monitor for increased antipsychotic side effects (sedation, extrapyramidal symptoms, orthostasis); consider dose adjustment of fluphenazine if CNS effects emerge; maintain clinical vigilance during concurrent use.
